summary: Explains urlsplit (2.4+), which extracts hostname, netloc, username, password, path, port, scheme, query or fragment from a URL, or returns all as a dict.
questions: How do I get the hostname from a URL in Ansible?
How do I extract the port from a URL string?
Can I split a URL into all its parts?

answer_card.title: Splitting URLs with urlsplit
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ url | urlsplit('hostname') }}   # www.acme.com
{{ url | urlsplit('port') }}       # 9000
{{ url | urlsplit('path') }}       # /dir/index.html
{{ url | urlsplit }}               # dict of all fields
```

Fields: `fragment`, `hostname`, `netloc`, `password`, `path`, `port`, `query`, `scheme`, `username`.
